name: NETCLASS TECHNOLOGY INC
summary: NetClass Technology Inc, operating through its subsidiaries, provides an online platform for professional education and accompanying courseware. Its services span the People's Republic of China, Hong Kong, Singapore, and the Cayman Islands. The company's extensive range of solution modules includes tools for managing teaching and campus administration, online instruction, digital examinations, and epidemic prevention and control. It also offers sophisticated data storage and computing systems, an EDC blockchain system, and services for evaluating lecturer performance. Beyond its core educational platform, NetClass Technology Inc delivers intelligent information technology (IT) solutions tailored for a broad clientele. This includes schools, training organizations, corporate entities, public agencies, and other institutional clients. The company also offers software-as-a-service (SaaS) subscriptions and custom application development. Furthermore, NetClass provides its proprietary mobile learning platforms, AI-assisted online education systems, and comprehensive IT consulting and data analysis solutions. Incorporated in 2022, NetClass Technology Inc is headquartered in Shanghai, People's Republic of China, and operates as a subsidiary of Dragonsoft Holding Limited.
